column1: # Lucene 10.5.0 lucene-core: every top-level class of the jar, and what became of it.
# Checked by scripts/check-port-inventory.py (see its docstring for the statuses).

column3: Base class of the SPI name-based factory plumbing (Solr/CustomAnalyzer configuration); Rust composes analyzers directly in code.
JVM ServiceLoader lookup of analysis factories by name; no Rust equivalent needed.

crates/lucene-analysis/src/automaton.rs::automaton_to_token_stream -- M7: converts to/from this crate's minimal Automaton (states, accept bits, canonical sorted transitions, differential-tested state for state against Java), not util/automaton's Automaton, which lucene-util is porting alongside; switch the type when that lands
char[]-keyed map that exists to avoid String allocation on the JVM; its only core use is backing CharArraySet, and Rust's HashMap<String,_> covers it.
SPI name-based factory plumbing for CharFilters; no behaviour beyond construction by name.
JVM char[]/codepoint buffer helpers; the one behavioural piece (simple toLowerCase) lives in lucene-analysis::simple_to_lowercase.
SPI name-based factory plumbing for TokenFilters; no behaviour beyond construction by name.

SPI name-based factory plumbing for Tokenizers; no behaviour beyond construction by name.
SPI name-based factory for StandardTokenizer; construction plumbing only.
Abstract heap-buffering KnnVectorsWriter base that no lucene-core format extends (only SimpleText/test codecs); the port buffers vectors in IndexWriter (DocumentVector) for its one vectors format.
NamedSPILoader codec registry/lookup-by-name; the port hard-wires the Lucene104 format set and rejects any other codec name at the CodecUtil header check.
Codec-delegation base for swapping formats inside the SPI codec registry; the port has no pluggable codec object to wrap.
Skip-list reader used by no 10.5.0 lucene-core format; only the pre-Lucene99 postings formats in backward-codecs use it.
Skip-list writer used by no 10.5.0 lucene-core format; only the pre-Lucene99 postings formats in backward-codecs use it.
Factory returning the VectorizationProvider-chosen (Panama or default) flat scorer; the port has one scorer and picks SIMD kernels at compile time.
Performance-only wrapper that issues IndexInput.prefetch for off-heap vectors before delegating; scores are unchanged.
Scores the Lucene99 scalar-quantized format (ScalarQuantizer), whose format lives in backward-codecs in 10.5.0; its only core caller is Lucene99ScalarQuantizedVectorScorer.
